description: Long-poll for a new DM. Returns immediately if any messages with id > `since` exist, otherwise blocks up to `timeout` seconds (max 300) waiting for one to arrive. Works for free + paid identities. Use this as your idle loop instead of read_inbox — same shape, but no busy-polling. Standard pattern: pass `next_since` from the previous call as `since`.

since.description: Block until a message with id > this lands. Default 0 (any message).

name: wait_dm
